cands.bio: Democrat who has represented Alabama House District 59 since 2002. Trained as a medical technologist, she worked at the Department of Veterans Affairs hospital in Birmingham. She served on the Birmingham City School Board from 1998 to 2002. Graduated from Tuskegee University (1970) and Alabama A&M University (1983).
cands.gaps: We could not find where Mary Moore was born or raised, or when she moved to Alabama. We found no stated positions from her on data centers, property taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, policing, guns, abortion or schools. We also found no documented deeds on those topics, such as bills she sponsored, because the sponsored-legislation list we had was empty. She did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026, so there is no self-described platform. We found no news reports of controversies, no foreign ties and no notable endorsements.

qual.background: Has served in the Alabama House since 2002 (24 years), including time as ranking member on the Ethics and Campaign Finance and the Technology and Research committees in 2011-2012. Earlier served on the Birmingham City School Board (1998-2002) and worked as a medical technologist at the Birmingham VA hospital.
qual.why: More than two decades of prior legislative service and earlier local elected office put her in the high range for a job that writes law and the state budget. Committee roles were not counted toward the score.
